# Basic R Syntax Exercise

This exercise uses variables, arithmetic, and logical comparisons in R.

```{r}
puppies <- 3
puppy_price <- 300
budget <- 1000

total_cost <- puppies * puppy_price
too_expensive <- total_cost > budget
max_puppies <- budget %/% puppy_price

print(total_cost)
print(too_expensive)
print(max_puppies)
```

## Results

- Total cost: $900
- Too expensive: FALSE
- Maximum puppies within budget: 3
